correctness.rationale: For X=Bl_p(P^2) glued to a second copy along its (-1)-exceptional P^1, the local transverse equation is uv=0 and each normal bundle N_{E/F1}=O_{P1}(-1), so the standard double-locus formula gives sheaf Ext^1=O_E(-2) !=0 with zero H^0. Verified the sequence 0->T_X->T_{F1}(-log E)^(direct sum 2)->T_E->0; the P2-stabilizer of p acts as all PGL2 on E, giving surjection on global tangent sections. R^1 ruling pushforward of T_rel=0 and pi_*T_rel=O(-1)⊕O⊕O(1) imply H^1(F1,T_F1)=H^1(F1,T_F1(-log E))=0, hence H^1(X,T_X)=0. The local-to-global Ext exact sequence then forces global Ext^1(Ω_X,O_X)=0. Ample anti-canonical bundles restrict compatibly to O_E(1) and descend from finite normalization, so X is projective. No claims on affine cones or higher-order deformations.
